title: Inertia Estimator Configuration
description: Regional inertia estimation (DEMO2 regional aggregation + Kalman filter). Subscribes to ParaEMT-shaped frequency, generator_electrical_power and tie_line_flow streams; publishes the regional signal per sample and one inertia estimate per window.

region.title: Region
region.description: WECC region to aggregate (fixed DEMO2 region definitions). The bundled day 6 hour 1 Player data only contains CA1 channels.

window_sec.title: Window Length (s)
window_sec.description: An estimate is published once the buffered samples span this many seconds of payload time. Windows do not overlap, and a partial window at the end of the input is discarded. 16.01 puts the whole 16 s DEMO2 snapshot in one window.
